title: Privacy Policy
metaDescription: Privacy Policy for Jawab24 — answers your customers on Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp
introText: Jawab24 ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our Facebook and Instagram auto-reply service at jawab24.com.
collectText: When you use Jawab24, we collect:
collectItem1: Facebook and Instagram Account Information: Your name, email, and profile picture when you log in with Facebook.
collectItem2: Facebook Page and Instagram Account Data: Information about Pages and Instagram accounts you manage, including page name, ID, and access tokens.
collectItem3: Comments and Messages: Content of comments and messages on your connected Pages to provide auto-reply functionality.
collectItem4: Business Information: Any business details you provide to customize AI-generated replies.
collectItem5: E-commerce Catalog Data: When you connect a Shopify, Salla, or Zid store, we receive your product catalog (titles, descriptions, prices, inventory, images, policies) so the AI can answer customer questions with accurate store data.
collectItem6: E-commerce Customer and Order Data: For order-status, shipment, and abandoned-cart features, we receive customer contact details (name, phone, email) and order data (line items, totals, statuses) from your connected store.
useItem1: Provide and maintain our auto-reply service
useItem2: Generate intelligent responses to comments and messages
useItem4: Communicate with you about service updates
useItem5: Answer customer questions about your connected store's products, prices, inventory, and policies
useItem6: Deliver merchant-configured customer notifications (order updates, shipment tracking, abandoned-cart recovery)
geoText: We may collect and process limited geolocation information, such as IP-derived country or region, for purposes of security, fraud prevention, and compliance with legal and regulatory obligations, including sanctions and payment restrictions. This processing is based on our legitimate interests and, where applicable, our obligation to comply with applicable laws.
shareText: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with:
shareItem1: OpenAI: Comment/message content is sent to OpenAI to generate replies. This data is processed according to OpenAI's privacy policy.
shareItem2: Meta (Facebook & Instagram): We interact with Meta's APIs to read and respond to comments and messages on your Facebook Pages and Instagram accounts on your behalf.
shareItem3: Service Providers: We use cloud hosting providers to operate our service.
shareItem4: Shopify: When you connect a Shopify store, we exchange data with Shopify's APIs (catalog read, order read, webhook subscriptions) per your authorization scopes. Shopify processes this data under its own privacy policy.
shareItem5: Salla: When you connect a Salla store, we exchange data with Salla's APIs (products, orders, abandoned carts, webhooks) per your authorization scopes. Salla processes this data under its own privacy policy.
shareItem6: Zid: When you connect a Zid store, we exchange data with Zid's APIs (products, orders, webhooks) per your authorization scopes. Zid processes this data under its own privacy policy.
shareItem7: Vonage: We use Vonage to deliver SMS notifications (order updates, abandoned-cart recovery) to your store's customers when this feature is enabled.
shareItem8: Resend: We use Resend to send transactional emails (account, waitlist, and service notifications). Only the recipient address and the message content needed to send the email are shared.
shareItem9: Sentry: We use Sentry for error monitoring and performance diagnostics. Sentry may receive limited technical data (error messages and request metadata) so we can detect and fix problems.
shareItem10: Google: We use Google Analytics 4 to understand how our website and dashboard are used, and Google Ads to measure how effective our advertising is. Google receives your IP address, device and browser information, the pages you visit, and a randomly generated identifier stored in the _ga cookie. We also send Google a small number of account milestones from our own servers — for example that an account was created, a Page was connected, or a subscription was purchased, together with its amount — so we can tell which advertising brings merchants to Jawab24. We never send Google the content of your comments, messages, customer conversations, or business information.
analyticsText: We use a small number of cookies and similar technologies:
analyticsItem1: Essential cookies: Required for you to sign in, stay signed in, and for protecting requests against cross-site request forgery. These cannot be turned off without breaking the service.
analyticsItem2: Google Analytics (_ga, _ga_*): A randomly generated identifier that lets us count visitors and understand which pages and features are used. It does not contain your name or email address.
analyticsItem3: Google signals: If you are signed in to a Google account that has Ads Personalization enabled, Google may associate your visits to Jawab24 with that account to improve advertising measurement and reporting.
analyticsItem4: Server-side measurement: When you reach a milestone such as creating an account, connecting a Page, or purchasing a subscription, our servers report that event to Google Analytics together with the identifier from the _ga cookie, so we can tell which advertising worked. This never includes message content or customer data.
analyticsItem5: Your choices: You can block or delete these cookies in your browser at any time, or install Google's official opt-out add-on at https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout. Blocking them does not affect your ability to use Jawab24.
ecommerceText: When you connect a Shopify, Salla, or Zid store, the following applies in addition to the general data-handling sections above:
ecommerceItem1: Encrypted Tokens: We store your store's access and refresh tokens encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM). Tokens are decrypted only at the moment of an outbound API call.
ecommerceItem2: Catalog Sync: Product data is synced into our database to power AI replies. We do not share catalog data with third parties beyond the AI provider used to generate replies.
ecommerceItem3: Customer Data Minimization: For each customer, we store only what is needed to deliver the configured features (e.g. phone for SMS notifications, social ID for DM mapping). We do not collect payment details, full addresses, or store-side customer profiles.
ecommerceItem4: Webhook Data: We receive webhook events (orders, products, app uninstall, GDPR) and process them solely to keep the integration current and to deliver merchant-configured notifications.
ecommerceItem5: Disconnection and Deletion: When you disconnect a store or uninstall the app from the store's admin, we mark the store inactive, stop processing its webhooks, and delete its synced data on request.
ecommerceItem6: Shopify GDPR Endpoints: For Shopify stores, we honor Shopify's mandatory GDPR webhooks (customers/data_request, customers/redact, shop/redact) per Shopify Partner Program requirements.
securityText: We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption, secure servers, and access controls to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.
residencyText: Your data is hosted on dedicated servers we operate in the European Union (Germany/Finland), protected by encryption and strict access controls. For merchants and their customers in Saudi Arabia, personal data processed under the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) is transferred to and stored on these EU servers under appropriate safeguards; by connecting your store and using the Service you consent to this cross-border processing.
retentionText: We retain your data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide our services. When you request deletion, we delete your personal data from our active systems within 30 days. Residual copies in encrypted backups are purged within the normal backup-rotation cycle (up to 90 days).
childrenText: Jawab24 is a business-to-business service intended for merchants and businesses. It is not directed to children, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under the age of 18. If you believe a minor has provided us with personal data, contact us and we will delete it.
rightsText: Under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL), you — and, where applicable, your store's customers — have the right to:
rightsItem4: Disconnect your Facebook Pages and Instagram accounts
rightsItem5: Revoke Facebook or Instagram permissions at any time. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (Integritetsskyddsmyndigheten, IMY) at imy.se
rightsItem6: Where you or your customers are located in Saudi Arabia, the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) governs the processing of personal data described in this policy. You may lodge a complaint with the Saudi Data & Artificial Intelligence Authority (SDAIA).
deletionText: To delete your data, you can either:
deletionItem1: Log into Jawab24 and delete your account from settings
deletionItem2: Remove the Jawab24 app from your Facebook settings
deletionItem3: Contact us at the email below
deletionItem4: Disconnect e-commerce stores from your settings, or uninstall the Jawab24 app from your Shopify, Salla, or Zid admin
changesText: We process your data based on: (a) your consent when you connect your Facebook/Instagram account, (b) contractual necessity to provide our auto-reply service, and (c) legitimate interests for security, fraud prevention, and service improvement. We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.
contactText: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
corporateAddress: Registered Address: Bergavägen 15 A lgh 1002, 241 39 Eslöv, Sweden
